gen-nixie-one-gf-suwannaphum: Tall, wide-mouthed lowercase gives the text a dignified, editorial read, while Nixie One keeps a constant stroke. Suwannaphum holds up through pages of text with steady poise, its tall lowercase keeping each line easy to follow.
gen-nosifer-fs-paquito: Paquito feels confident and approachable, with lowercase that barely steps down from its capitals. But Nosifer is a dark, widely tracked shout rather than a paragraph voice, while Paquito does the talking.
gen-permanent-marker-fs-epilogue: Permanent Marker swaggers with hand-drawn grunge, its curves pinched to small slots while the lowercase balloons wide. Epilogue, wiry and approachable, stays happiest in brief copy rather than endless text.
gen-permanent-marker-fs-hind: Rough meets ruled: Permanent Marker brings hand-drawn grunge with pinched, slot-like curves. Hind counters those closed shapes with open, steady strokes, though neither font is built for long paragraphs.
gen-permanent-marker-fs-public-sans: Grunge leads here, with Permanent Marker pinching its curves into slots while Public Sans stays hefty and broad-countered below. Brief copy is where this pair works; a generous heading size helps.
gen-permanent-marker-fs-supreme: Permanent Marker scrawls grunge-bold, with curves pinched into small slots and a hand-drawn swagger that suits brief copy. Supreme brings the sharpest contrast: crisp, heavy-looking text held open against the closed marker shapes.
gen-permanent-marker-general-sans: Slot-pinched curves and a hand-drawn grunge give Permanent Marker its bite, good for a couple of lines. General Sans takes over with smooth, steady-pressure strokes and an x-height that fills the line.
gen-permanent-marker-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, every curve leaving a clear gap and the lowercase barely dropping from the capitals. And next to Permanent Marker, its open letters feel made for quick bursts rather than marathons.
gen-permanent-marker-satoshi: Hand-drawn grunge defines Permanent Marker, with curves pinched into small slots beside a big, open lowercase. Satoshi, with its soaring x-height and unshaded outline, is happiest in brisk bursts of reading.
gen-permanent-marker-switzer: Grunge and boldness drive Permanent Marker, while Switzer draws wire-like letters with tips that never creep toward touching. Expect Swiss tidiness in modest helpings, not endless pages of text.
